code: # Using data on Hospital Admitted Patient Care Activity, 2019-20 # https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/publications/statistical/hospital-admitted-patient-care-activity/2019-20/summary-reports---apc---patient  temp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx") download.file(url = "https://digital.nhs.uk/binaries/content/documents/corporate-website/publication-system/statistical/hospital-admitted-patient-care-activity/2019-20/summary-reports---apc---patient/summary-reports---apc---patient/publicationsystem%3AbodySections%5B2%5D/publicationsystem%3AdataFile",               temp, mode = "wb")  hospital_cohort <- as.data.table(readxl::read_xlsx(temp, sheet = 1)) |>   setnames(new = c("age", "male", "female")) |>   melt(measure.vars = c("male", "female"),        variable.name = "sex",        value.name = "count")  hospital_cohort <- hospital_cohort[age != "Unknown"][   , lower := as.numeric(substring(age, 1, 2)) ][   , upper := lower + 4 ][   , .(age = c(lower:upper), count = rep(count/5, 5)), by = c("lower", "upper", "sex") ][   , c("lower", "upper"):=NULL ] default_cohort <- package_cohort(country = "England", year = 2020)  ggplot() +   geom_line(data = default_cohort,                aes(x = age, y = count/sum(count), colour = sex), linetype = 2) +   geom_line(data = hospital_cohort,                aes(x = age, y = count/sum(count), colour = sex)) +   theme_classic() +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) calculate_dQALY(country = "England", year = 2020,                 collapse_age = all_ages,                 collapse_sex = TRUE,                 cohort = hospital_cohort) #>     age lower upper   dQALY #> 1 0-100     0   100 12.7969 adj_hospital_cohort <- copy(hospital_cohort)[age > 60, count := count*1.5]  calculate_dQALY(country = "England", year = 2020,                 collapse_age = all_ages,                 collapse_sex = TRUE,                 cohort = adj_hospital_cohort) #>     age lower upper    dQALY #> 1 0-100     0   100 11.63132

text: third last type function provided package discounting function. get net present value society quality-adjusted life years ‘lost’ individual dies, typically apply discount rate reflects idea , us present, value QALYs experienced years future less value QALYs experienced today. package, default discount rate set 3.5% per NICE health technology evaluations manual. However, appropriate discount rate apply differ according context evaluation/analysis. Green Book, guidance evaluation methods issued Treasury, discusses number discounting regimes reasons one might use . function calculate_dQALY allows user specify discount rate like use calculation via setting value argument r. r can scalar numeric (e.g. discount rate 1%, set r = 0.01) , discount rate can vary across time, r also accepts vectorised functions (e.g. discount rate 2% year 50 years future 1% year thereafter, set r = function(x) ifelse(x < 50, 0.02, 0.01)). package includes four discount rate functions users can pass calculate_dQALY, implements particular discounting regime recommended NICE HTA manual Green Book: plots show values discount rate functions across time, impact varying discount rates estimates QALY loss associated death across life-course.
